text:
maria: Starting a planned EU->APAC traffic gating failover drill tomorrow 22:00 UTC. Expect stepwise shifts and a short maintenance window. Who will be on deployment and smoke?

aj: I'll be primary deploy lead. I'll handle the route swap commands and keep a running checklist.

lee: I'll own smoke tests + logs. Will run the synthetic hit list and trace traces.

samir: I'll be standby for rollback and perf tuning. Runbook is patched with DNS TTL rollback steps.

maria: Thanks. Plan is: 22:00 start, 22:05 5% shift, 22:20 25%, 22:40 75%, 23:00 100% (final cut). Each step gated on 5m steady-state and <1% 5xx and p95 latency within 20% of baseline.

aj: Sounds good. I'll post the exact commands in the deploy channel when we go. Quick checklist I'll use:
```
1) pause autoscaler
2) set routing policy -> prefer apac (weight 5)
3) apply health-probe timeout 2s -> verify
4) step weight up (5,25,75,100)
5) monitor token-level latency dashboards
```

lee: Smoke list (short):
- run curl on /health endpoints from EU and APAC
- hit representative LLM route with 512 tokens
- verify KV cache hit rate not regressing
- sanity-check embeddings pipeline

samir: Rollback notes:
- DNS TTL currently 60s; if rollback, restore weight to EU and set TTL to 30 for quick reversion.
- keep `rollback-ready` tag on instances
- `kubectl rollout undo` plan is in runbook

devops: Reminder: update infra-alerting to include the APAC region overlay during the drill, and suppress noisy PagerDuty for minor 5xx blips (we'll look at trend not single events).

maria: Gate conditions reiterated: if 5xx >1% or p95 > +20% for 2 consecutive minutes during a step, we pause and either revert to previous weight or hold. aj you will call the pause.

aj: Acknowledged. I'll also post the dig/nslookup checks I run: `dig +short txt route-version.example.com` and `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" <endpoint>` for latency.

lee: I'll tail the tracing spans: `rb tail --service=inference --env=prod --since=5m`. If any regressions, I'll ping @samir and tag #eng-oncall.

maria: One more ask — can someone validate the canary fallback model exists in APAC GPUs? If not we use CPU fallback with lower throughput.

samir: Confirmed: canary model v2 is on two APAC nodes with 8g mem each. Throughput baseline lower but acceptable for drill.

oncall-bot: Runbook link: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/xxx|EU->APAC traffic gating runbook> :bookmark: 

maria: OK. Final: deploy leads aj + lee, rollback lead samir, infra watch devops. We'll run a quick preflight at 20:30 UTC (today) to sanity-check health-probes and dig TTL. Please ack. :thumbsup:
